value.title: Give existing roles a type (workstream 006 s04)
value.summary: `pij directory retype` proposes a type for every untyped role from its template and then its id, writes those it is sure of with `--apply` in one governance commit, and lists the rest with the line that types each.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: `pij directory retype` proposes a type for every untyped role from its template and then its id, writes those it is sure of with `--apply` in one governance commit, and lists the rest with the line that types each.

sections.name: goals
value: A community written before PRD 006 is typed with one command.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Guessing a type it is not sure of: undecided roles are listed, never typed.

value.claim: `pij directory retype` (no flag) prints, per untyped role, the proposed type and its source (template or id), and each undecided role with its `pij directory edit <id> --type <type>` line; it writes nothing.

`retype --apply --why <text>` writes every proposed type in one governance commit, restamps the open holdings (plan 237) and prints what it wrote and what it left. A role whose proposed type requires a field it lacks (knowledge: keeps) is left undecided and named.

Proposals: the template table in the type catalog first; then the id (`prime`, `pa`, `pm` or `pm-<n>` to project-manager, `coder*` to coder, `reviewer*`, `security*` and `qa*` to reviewer). Run again, it finds nothing to do.

value.title: Give existing roles a type (workstream 006 s04)

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: Same files as plan 236; the proposal is a pure function in community/types.rs over (id, template).

value.mitigation: Only the template table and exact id patterns propose; everything else is listed for the prime.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Cost: on demand only: one in-process read of the role documents; `--apply` is one writer commit (the launches a governance write makes today). No loop, poll or timer.
No permission rule changes (PRD 003); no daemon enforcement of a type's rules; no existing JSON field removed or renamed.
Builds nice-19 through `just shared-build`, one at a time.
